name: v0.9.4
body: [English](#english) | [中文](#chinese) ## Highlights - **New: `miuix-nav` module** — a self-contained Compose Multiplatform navigation runtime with continuous stack depth (`animatedTop`), slide/modal transitions, predictive back, opt-in swipe-to-dismiss, and entry lifecycle / state management. Replaces `miuix-navigation3-ui` with **zero dependency** on `androidx.navigation3`. - **New: `BreadcrumbBar` component** — horizontally scrollable capsule-shaped path segments, configurable highlighting and colors, plus `BreadcrumbItem` and `joinToPath()` helpers. - **`miuix-blur` gains progressive blur** — `Modifier.progressiveTextureBlur()`, `BackdropEffectScope.progressiveBlur()`, and `ProgressiveBlur` presets (`Top` / `Bottom` / `Left` / `Right`) provide directional blur with a sharp clear end. The gradient band and falloff curve are configurable. - **Pager gesture conflict resolution** — new `Modifier.pagerGestureOverride()` utilities let horizontal swipes switch pages while a vertical list is flinging or overscrolling. Choose native, cross-axis interception, or tap-to-halt behavior; `PagerState.springAnimateToPage()` adds spring-based page navigation. - **Navigation state and integration** — `LocalNavTransitionScope` exposes the current entry's live transition state, including `isRunning`; navigation entries now inherit the SavedState creation extras and ViewModel factory needed by `SavedStateHandle` and integrations such as Hilt. Back events are bridged across separate Android windows. - **Navigation component customization** — `NavigationBarItem` and `FloatingNavigationBarItem` gain `colors`; `NavigationRail` restores the compact selection highlight and separates fixed-layout and expandable overloads. - **More configurable dialogs** — `OverlayDialog` / `WindowDialog` gain `maxWidth`, `largeScreen`, and `cornerRadius`. Centered dialogs use a fixed 32dp default corner radius. - **Scrolling and refresh improvements** — `PullToRefresh` separates its trigger threshold from indicator scaling; `TabRow` and `TabRowWithContour` contain horizontal overscroll instead of passing it to a parent pager; overscroll and refresh handling now distinguish actual gesture sessions from wheel input. - **Platform and tooling updates** — Compose Multiplatform **1.12.0**, Kotlin **2.4.20**, Lifecycle **2.11.0**, AGP **9.4.1**, and Gradle **9.7.1**. The shared Android minimum SDK rises from 23 to **24**; `miuix-blur` continues to require API **33**. ## ⚠️ Breaking Changes ### 1. `miuix-navigation3-ui` removed, replaced by `miuix-nav` Replace the dependency and migrate the Navigation3 imports and back-stack code to the new runtime. This is not a drop-in artifact rename: `NavKey`, `rememberNavBackStack`, `NavDisplay`, and `NavController` now belong to Miuix. ```kotlin // Old dependency implementation("top.yukonga.miuix.kmp:miuix-navigation3-ui:0.9.3") // New dependency implementation("top.yukonga.miuix.kmp:miuix-nav:0.9.4") ``` ```kotlin import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.NavDisplay import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.NavKey import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.rememberNavBackStack @Serializable sealed interface Route : NavKey { @Serializable data object Home : Route } @Composable fun App() { val backStack = rememberNavBackStack(Route.Home) NavDisplay( backStack = backStack, onBack = { backStack.removeLastOrNull() }, ) { entry { HomeScreen() } } } ``` Use the route **supertype** as the explicit type argument so the whole serializable route hierarchy can be saved and restored. Swipe-to-dismiss is opt-in via `entry(swipeDismiss = …)`; built-in transition presets do not enable it automatically. Access `LocalNavTransitionScope.current` only inside a `NavDisplay` entry. See the [miuix-nav guide](https://compose-miuix-ui.github.io/miuix/guide/miuix-nav.html) for transitions, predictive back, and state restoration. ### 2. Shared Android `minSdk` 23 → 24 Modules using `BuildConfig.MIN_SDK` now require API 24. Apps consuming those artifacts must raise `minSdk` from 23 to at least 24. `miuix-blur` retains its separate API 33 requirement. ### 3. `RadioButtonPreference`: individual text colors replaced by `colors` `titleColor`, `selectedTitleColor`, `summaryColor`, and `selectedSummaryColor` moved from the composable signature into `RadioButtonPreferenceColors`. `summary` also moved earlier in the parameter list; affected positional calls need to use named arguments. ```kotlin // Old RadioButtonPreference( title = "Option", selected = selected, onClick = { }, titleColor = titleColors, selectedTitleColor = selectedTitleColors, summary = "Description", summaryColor = summaryColors, selectedSummaryColor = selectedSummaryColors, ) // New RadioButtonPreference( title = "Option", selected = selected, onClick = { }, summary = "Description", colors = RadioButtonPreferenceDefaults.radioButtonPreferenceColors( titleColor = titleColors, selectedTitleColor = selectedTitleColors, summaryColor = summaryColors, selectedSummaryColor = selectedSummaryColors, ), ) ``` Selected title and summary text now use the theme primary color by default. The radio button's interaction is routed through the entire preference row. ### 4. `NavigationRail`: nullable `state` split into two overloads The previous `state: NavigationRailState? = null` signature is replaced by: - A fixed-layout overload with `expanded: Boolean = false` and no `state` parameter. It has no built-in toggle or expansion animation. - An expandable overload with required, non-null `state: NavigationRailState` as its **first** parameter, followed by `modifier`. ```kotlin // Old: fixed compact rail NavigationRail(state = null) { /* items */ } // New: fixed compact rail NavigationRail { /* items */ } // New: fixed expanded layout, without a built-in toggle NavigationRail(expanded = true) { /* items */ } // Expandable rail: named state calls remain valid val railState = rememberNavigationRailState() NavigationRail(state = railState) { /* items */ } ``` Remove explicit `state = null`, branch before calling if your state is nullable, and convert positional calls to named arguments. `expandContentDescription` and `collapseContentDescription` now belong only to the state-based overload. The fixed compact rail also gains a visible background behind the selected icon. ### 5. Navigation items: `colors` inserted before `badge` `NavigationBarItem` and `FloatingNavigationBarItem` now accept `colors: NavigationBarItemColors` between `enabled` and `badge`. Calls that pass `badge` positionally inside parentheses must switch to `badge = …`; named arguments and trailing badge lambdas remain valid. Both components use `NavigationBarDefaults.navigationBarItemColors(unselectedContentColor = …, selectedContentColor = …)`. State opacity multiplies the supplied color's alpha, preserving transparent and translucent colors. ### 6. `InputField` and `drawBackdrop`: new parameters affect positional calls - `InputField` gains `color: Color` between `textStyle` and `leadingIcon`. Use named arguments for `leadingIcon` and later parameters. The default background is unchanged; `color = Color.Transparent` supports a custom backdrop behind the input capsule. - `Modifier.drawBackdrop` gains `progressiveGradient: ProgressiveBlur? = null` immediately before `enabled`. If you passed the final Boolean positionally, change it to `enabled = …`. Calls that omit these optional parameters or already use named arguments remain source-compatible. ### 7. `PullToRefresh`: trigger threshold and progress semantics `rememberPullToRefreshState(refreshThreshold: Float = 0.25f)` configures the trigger as a fraction of the full damped drag range, clamped to `0f..1f`. Calling it without arguments remains valid. - `pullProgress` is relative to the **larger** of the built-in visual threshold and the configured trigger threshold. - `fullDragProgress` tracks the complete damped drag range. - `visualProgress` controls indicator scaling and reaches its maximum at the **smaller** of those thresholds. Consequently, `pullProgress == 1f` and `visualProgress == 1f` are not universal tests for whether releasing will trigger refresh. Custom indicators should use `refreshState == RefreshState.ThresholdReached` for the armed state. Refresh completion is height-continuous, and programmatic refresh can follow a threshold that changes after the initial layout. ### 8. Centered dialogs no longer inherit the screen corner radius The centered presentation of `OverlayDialog` and `WindowDialog` now uses `DialogDefaults.CornerRadius` (32dp). The bottom-attached presentation retains the screen-derived radius, clamped to 32dp–48dp. Set `cornerRadius = …` to override either presentation; `largeScreen` explicitly selects centered or bottom-attached presentation, and `maxWidth` limits width. **Binary compatibility note**: public signatures changed for navigation, preference, dialog, refresh, input, and backdrop APIs, including functions with newly defaulted parameters. Libraries precompiled against 0.9.3 or 0.9.4-rc01 should be recompiled against 0.9.4. ## What's Changed ### New Features - Add miuix-nav module by @YuKongA in https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/346 - feat: implement BreadcrumbBar by @Miuzarte in https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/371 - library: miuix-blur: add progressive blur support by @YuKongA in https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/381 - library: add pager gesture conflict resolution utilities by @YuKongA in https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/437 - made their first contribution in https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/402 - @phucynwa made their first contribution in https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/414 - @1812z made their first contribution in https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/pull/427 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix/compare/v0.9.3...v0.9.4 --- ## 亮点 - **新增：`miuix-nav` 模块** — 独立的 Compose Multiplatform 导航运行时，以连续栈深度（`animatedTop`）为核心，支持滑动 / 模态转场、预测性返回、按需启用的手势关闭，以及页面生命周期与状态管理。替代 `miuix-navigation3-ui`，**不再依赖** `androidx.navigation3`。 - **新增：`BreadcrumbBar` 组件** — 以胶囊路径段展示层级导航，支持横向滚动、自定义高亮与配色，并提供 `BreadcrumbItem` 和 `joinToPath()` 辅助 API。 - **`miuix-blur` 支持渐进模糊** — 新增 `Modifier.progressiveTextureBlur()`、`BackdropEffectScope.progressiveBlur()` 与 `ProgressiveBlur` 方向预设（`Top` / `Bottom` / `Left` / `Right`）。支持自定义渐变区间与衰减曲线，清晰端保持锐利。 - **Pager 手势冲突处理** — 新增 `Modifier.pagerGestureOverride()` 等工具，支持在纵向列表惯性滚动或过度滚动回弹期间横向切页；提供原生、跨轴拦截和先停止惯性三种模式，并通过 `PagerState.springAnimateToPage()` 实现弹簧切页。 - **导航状态与集成能力增强** — `LocalNavTransitionScope` 提供当前页面的实时转场状态及 `isRunning`；导航页面正确继承 SavedState 创建参数与 ViewModel 工厂，修复 `SavedStateHandle` 和 Hilt 等集成场景。支持跨独立 Android 窗口桥接返回事件。 - **导航组件支持更多自定义** — `NavigationBarItem` / `FloatingNavigationBarItem` 新增 `colors`；`NavigationRail` 恢复紧凑布局的选中高亮，并拆分固定布局与可展开重载。 - **对话框新增尺寸与形态参数** — `OverlayDialog` / `WindowDialog` 新增 `maxWidth`、`largeScreen`、`cornerRadius`，居中展示默认使用固定 32dp 圆角。 - **滚动与刷新体验改进** — `PullToRefresh` 触发阈值与指示器缩放解耦；`TabRow` / `TabRowWithContour` 自行处理横向过度滚动，避免传递给父级 Pager；过度滚动与下拉刷新现在区分真实手势会话和滚轮输入。 - **平台与工具链升级** — Compose Multiplatform **1.12.0**、Kotlin **2.4.20**、Lifecycle **2.11.0**、AGP **9.4.1**、Gradle **9.7.1**。共用的 Android 最低 SDK 由 23 升至 **24**；`miuix-blur` 仍要求 API **33**。 ## ⚠️ 破坏性更改 ### 1. `miuix-navigation3-ui` 移除，替换为 `miuix-nav` 需要替换依赖，并将 Navigation3 的导入与返回栈代码迁移至新运行时。此次不是简单的依赖改名：`NavKey`、`rememberNavBackStack`、`NavDisplay` 和 `NavController` 均为 Miuix 自身的 API。 ```kotlin // 旧依赖 implementation("top.yukonga.miuix.kmp:miuix-navigation3-ui:0.9.3") // 新依赖 implementation("top.yukonga.miuix.kmp:miuix-nav:0.9.4") ``` ```kotlin import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.NavDisplay import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.NavKey import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.rememberNavBackStack @Serializable sealed interface Route : NavKey { @Serializable data object Home : Route } @Composable fun App() { val backStack = rememberNavBackStack(Route.Home) NavDisplay( backStack = backStack, onBack = { backStack.removeLastOrNull() }, ) { entry { HomeScreen() } } } ``` 请显式使用路由**父类型**作为类型参数，以便完整的可序列化路由层级参与状态保存与恢复。手势关闭需通过 `entry(swipeDismiss = …)` 按需启用，内置转场预设不会默认启用。`LocalNavTransitionScope.current` 仅可在 `NavDisplay` 的页面内容中读取。 转场、预测性返回与状态恢复见 [miuix-nav 指南](https://compose-miuix-ui.github.io/miuix/zh_CN/guide/miuix-nav.html)。 ### 2. 共用的 Android `minSdk` 23 → 24 使用 `BuildConfig.MIN_SDK` 的模块现要求 API 24。依赖这些构件的应用需要将 `minSdk` 从 23 提升至至少 24。`miuix-blur` 保留其独立的 API 33 要求。 ### 3. `RadioButtonPreference`：独立文本颜色参数合并为 `colors` `titleColor`、`selectedTitleColor`、`summaryColor`、`selectedSummaryColor` 已从 composable 签名移入 `RadioButtonPreferenceColors`。`summary` 在参数列表中的位置也已前移，受影响的位置参数调用需改用具名参数。 ```kotlin // 旧 RadioButtonPreference( title = "Option", selected = selected, onClick = { }, titleColor = titleColors, selectedTitleColor = selectedTitleColors, summary = "Description", summaryColor = summaryColors, selectedSummaryColor = selectedSummaryColors, ) // 新 RadioButtonPreference( title = "Option", selected = selected, onClick = { }, summary = "Description", colors = RadioButtonPreferenceDefaults.radioButtonPreferenceColors( titleColor = titleColors, selectedTitleColor = selectedTitleColors, summaryColor = summaryColors, selectedSummaryColor = selectedSummaryColors, ), ) ``` 选中态标题与摘要默认使用主题主色；单选按钮的交互统一由整行偏好组件处理。 ### 4. `NavigationRail`：可空 `state` 拆分为两个重载 原来的 `state: NavigationRailState? = null` 签名被替换为： - 固定布局重载：使用 `expanded: Boolean = false`，不包含 `state` 参数，也不提供内置切换按钮与展开动画。 - 可展开重载：必填且非空的 `state: NavigationRailState` 位于**第一个**参数，`modifier` 位于其后。 ```kotlin // 旧：固定紧凑侧栏 NavigationRail(state = null) { /* items */ } // 新：固定紧凑侧栏 NavigationRail { /* items */ } // 新：固定展开布局，不显示内置切换按钮 NavigationRail(expanded = true) { /* items */ } // 可展开侧栏：具名 state 调用仍然有效 val railState = rememberNavigationRailState() NavigationRail(state = railState) { /* items */ } ``` 请移除显式的 `state = null`；如果持有可空状态，应在调用前分支处理；位置参数调用请改为具名参数。`expandContentDescription` 与 `collapseContentDescription` 现在仅属于带状态的重载。固定紧凑侧栏也会在选中图标后显示背景高亮。 ### 5. 导航项：`colors` 插入到 `badge` 之前 `NavigationBarItem` 和 `FloatingNavigationBarItem` 在 `enabled` 与 `badge` 之间新增 `colors: NavigationBarItemColors`。若此前在圆括号内以位置参数传入 `badge`，请改为 `badge = …`；具名参数与尾随 badge lambda 调用保持有效。 两个组件共用 `NavigationBarDefaults.navigationBarItemColors(unselectedContentColor = …, selectedContentColor = …)`。状态透明度与传入颜色的 alpha 相乘，保留透明与半透明配色的原有透明度。 ### 6. `InputField` 与 `drawBackdrop`：新增参数影响位置参数调用 - `InputField` 在 `textStyle` 与 `leadingIcon` 之间新增 `color: Color`。请对 `leadingIcon` 及之后的参数使用具名传参。默认背景色不变；传入 `color = Color.Transparent` 可在输入框胶囊后绘制自定义背景。 - `Modifier.drawBackdrop` 在 `enabled` 之前新增 `progressiveGradient: ProgressiveBlur? = null`。若此前以位置参数传入末尾布尔值，请改为 `enabled = …`。 省略这些可选参数或已经使用具名参数的调用保持源码兼容。 ### 7. `PullToRefresh`：触发阈值与进度语义变化 `rememberPullToRefreshState(refreshThreshold: Float = 0.25f)` 按完整阻尼下拉行程的比例配置触发阈值，取值限制在 `0f..1f`。无参数调用保持有效。 - `pullProgress` 以内置视觉阈值和配置触发阈值中的**较大值**为基准。 - `fullDragProgress` 表示完整阻尼下拉行程的进度。 - `visualProgress` 控制指示器缩放，在两种阈值中的**较小值**处达到最大。 因此，`pullProgress == 1f` 和 `visualProgress == 1f` 都不能普遍用于判断松手是否会触发刷新。自定义指示器应通过 `refreshState == RefreshState.ThresholdReached` 判断是否已达到触发状态。刷新完成动画保持高度连续，编程式刷新也能跟随首次布局后变化的阈值。 ### 8. 居中对话框不再继承屏幕圆角 `OverlayDialog` / `WindowDialog` 居中展示默认使用 `DialogDefaults.CornerRadius`（32dp）。底部弹出仍使用屏幕推导圆角，范围限制为 32dp–48dp。传入 `cornerRadius = …` 可覆盖对应展示的圆角；`largeScreen` 可显式选择居中或底部形态，`maxWidth` 用于限制宽度。
